subject: sources.yaml: link-only guideline rows for neuro/psych further reading
body:
S23-E needs link-only (tier 1) sources rows to cite guidelines in furtherReading/references. Proposed ids + URLs:
- aha-asa-guidelines  https://www.stroke.org/en/professionals/stroke-resource-library (AHA/ASA stroke guidelines; also covers ICH/SAH)
- aan-guidelines      https://www.aan.com/practice/guidelines (American Academy of Neurology)
- apa-practice-guidelines https://www.psychiatry.org/psychiatrists/practice/clinical-practice-guidelines
- aao-ppp             https://www.aao.org/education/preferred-practice-patterns (American Academy of Ophthalmology)
- aao-hns-guidelines  https://www.entnet.org/quality-practice/quality-products/clinical-practice-guidelines/
- samhsa              https://www.samhsa.gov (US federal; text public domain, but cite as link)
All license: link-only, allow_copy false. Until they exist I will cite statpearls / medlineplus-federal / cdc-guidelines only and add the guideline refs once you confirm the ids. Is that OK, or do you want a different naming?
